detect.command:
set -u
locks=0; mgr=none; signal=none; reason=ok
[ -f uv.lock ] && { mgr=uv; signal=uv.lock; locks=$((locks + 1)); }
[ -f poetry.lock ] && { mgr=poetry; signal=poetry.lock; locks=$((locks + 1)); }
venv="${VIRTUAL_ENV:-$PWD/.venv}"
if [ "$locks" -gt 1 ]; then
  mgr=none; signal=none; reason=ambiguous-manager
elif [ ! -x "$venv/bin/python" ] && [ ! -x "$venv/bin/python3" ]; then
  mgr=none; signal=none; reason=no-virtualenv
elif [ "$locks" -eq 0 ]; then
  if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
    mgr=pip; signal=requirements.txt
  elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
    mgr=pip; signal=pyproject.toml
  else
    mgr=none; signal=none; reason=no-python-manifest
  fi
fi
printf '{"ecosystem":"python","manager":"%s","reason":"%s","signal":"%s"}\n' \
  "$mgr" "$reason" "$signal"

enabledShifts.fallback: park unused-code suspects from static review; no automated dead-code report is available

maintenance.check: lastVerified older than 180 days, or the pinned floor stops resolving on the index

packageManagerAdditions.command:
set -u
venv="${VIRTUAL_ENV:-$PWD/.venv}"
py="$venv/bin/python"
[ -x "$py" ] || py="$venv/bin/python3"
[ -x "$py" ] || { printf 'no project virtual environment at %s\n' "$venv" >&2; exit 78; }
VIRTUAL_ENV="$venv"; PATH="$venv/bin:$PATH"; export VIRTUAL_ENV PATH
locks=0; mgr=pip
[ -f uv.lock ] && { mgr=uv; locks=$((locks + 1)); }
[ -f poetry.lock ] && { mgr=poetry; locks=$((locks + 1)); }
if [ "$locks" -gt 1 ]; then
  printf 'uv.lock and poetry.lock are both here; one manager owns a project, never two\n' >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ "$locks" -eq 0 ] && [ ! -f requirements.txt ] && [ ! -f pyproject.toml ]; then
  printf 'no python manifest here to analyze\n' >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -x "$venv/bin/vulture" ]; then
  printf 'vulture is already on PATH in this environment; the repository tooling wins\n' >&2
  exit 78
fi
case "$mgr" in
  uv) uv add --dev 'vulture>=2.14' ;;
  poetry) POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_CREATE=false poetry add --group dev 'vulture>=2.14' ;;
  pip)
    "$py" -m pip install 'vulture>=2.14' || exit 1
    if [ -f requirements-dev.txt ] && ! grep -q '^vulture' requirements-dev.txt; then
      printf 'vulture>=2.14\n' >>requirements-dev.txt
    fi
    ;;
esac

permissionRequirements: fallback: vulture reports unused code by static reachability only; dynamic imports and external consumers stay unverified and must be parked

probe.command:
set -u
venv="${VIRTUAL_ENV:-$PWD/.venv}"
present=false; via=none
if [ -x "$venv/bin/vulture" ]; then
  present=true; via=environment
fi
printf '{"capability":"dead-code","present":%s,"tool":"vulture","via":"%s"}\n' \
  "$present" "$via"

rollback.command:
set -u
venv="${VIRTUAL_ENV:-$PWD/.venv}"
py="$venv/bin/python"
[ -x "$py" ] || py="$venv/bin/python3"
[ -x "$py" ] || exit 0
VIRTUAL_ENV="$venv"; PATH="$venv/bin:$PATH"; export VIRTUAL_ENV PATH
if [ -f uv.lock ]; then
  uv remove --dev vulture
elif [ -f poetry.lock ]; then
  POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_CREATE=false poetry remove --group dev vulture
else
  "$py" -m pip uninstall -y vulture
fi

smoke.command:
set -u
venv="${VIRTUAL_ENV:-$PWD/.venv}"
py="$venv/bin/python"
[ -x "$py" ] || py="$venv/bin/python3"
[ -x "$py" ] || { printf 'no project virtual environment at %s\n' "$venv" >&2; exit 127; }
VIRTUAL_ENV="$venv"; PATH="$venv/bin:$PATH"; export VIRTUAL_ENV PATH
vulture . --min-confidence 80
